name: Macrame By Manar
headline:
Bring a little
texture home.
intro: Soft fringes. Quiet colours. Knotted details with a place in your everyday. Explore macrame home decor, bags and little gifts by Manar Ayoubi.
storyShort: From Btouratij in Koura, Manar Ayoubi creates macrame for the home, accessories and souvenirs for special occasions. Her pictured work brings together natural tones, texture and fringe.
storyLong: Macrame By Manar is the work of Manar Ayoubi, based in Btouratij, Koura. Her public portfolio brings together home decor, bags, accessories and souvenirs for occasions.
storySecond: A fringed mirror, a textured vessel, a bag with a knotted flap: each photograph is a starting point for exploring the work. Save the references you like and speak with Manar about colour, size, current options and pricing.
statement:
Natural tones. Soft edges.
A little more feeling in the everyday.
visit: Please contact Manar before visiting to confirm the location and a suitable time.
closingText: A finishing touch for home or a thoughtful little gift. Share your idea and ask Manar about the possibilities.
collectionIntro: Discover knotted textures for your home, your everyday and your next thoughtful gift. Choose a photo reference and discuss the details with Manar.
galleryIntro: Styled spaces, knotted details and pieces up close. Open a photograph to see its full composition.
